children: CME live cattle futures are up 0.2% after recent selling. "Cattle continued their pullback yesterday, closing sharply weaker on profit-taking and reports the USDA is set to reopen a border crossing in New Mexico this week," says the Hightower Report in a note. That recent weakness is seen as a "normal" correction, says the firm. Live cattle futures closed lower over the past two sessions, according to data from FactSet. Lean hog futures are flat in morning trading. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
